title: Scientists Spent 20 Years and Studied 7,500 Fossils to Finally Solve a Mystery That’s Puzzled Paleontology for Decades
description: Fossils buried side by side aren't always as close in age as they appear. After two decades of work, scientists finally uncovered the hidden factor that decides how much history gets mixed into a single layer of fossils.
